info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Deposit Lending Fiduciary Agreement-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of deposit lending fiduciary agreements, essential for managing client funds and ensuring compliant financial stewardship. It allows financial institutions to establish fiduciary relationships with clients, providing necessary documentation for deposit lending services. Typical users include banking professionals and compliance teams who require efficient means to draft and submit agreements. This service enhances operational efficiency and ensures adherence to regulatory requirements in fiduciary practices.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new fiduciary agreement within the deposit lending service. Providing the necessary details in the request body will result in the establishment of this financial agreement, ensuring all involved parties are legally bound by its terms.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a fiduciary agreement under the deposit lending operation. It includes all necessary information required to process the fiduciary agreement effectively.
